Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.economics

Class ProfitOilShareTable

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.economics.ProfitOilShareTable
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ProfitOilShareTable extends Object implements Serializable
Price and rate dependent adjustment of the State profit-oil share in a production-sharing contract.

Brazilian ANP production-sharing contracts (edital Annex XX) set the Union share of profit oil as the offered percentage plus a percentage-point adjustment. The adjustment depends on the Dated Brent price band and on the average oil rate per producing well. The packaged grid has 41 price bands and 101 rate bands.

Band conventions

  • Price band: the first band whose upper bound is greater than or equal to the price. The bands are 0 to 5, 5.01 to 10, and so on in steps of 5 USD per barrel up to 195.01 to 200, followed by an open-ended band above 200.01. A price of exactly 50.0 therefore falls in the 45.01 to 50 band and 50.004 falls in the 50.01 to 55 band.
  • Rate band: index is ceil(rate / 500) minus 1, clamped to 0 to 100, with rate in barrels per day per producing well. A rate of exactly 10,000 is in the band 9,500 to 10,000, which is the offered-share cell at Brent 50.
  • Cells whose source text is "1%" are stored as an adjustment of -100 percentage points, which the share floor of 1 percent turns into the contractual minimum.
